claim: Local sheaf generation/base-point-freeness of the actual global intrinsic bicanonical pair
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
external_input_scope: No new literature theorem. Actual frames, restriction and module/sheaf arguments are supplied by the pinned kernel-checked dependencies.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: The actual local module must be rank one with a normalized coordinate and an invertible coefficient.
obligations.constructed: A genuine restricted tensor frame is built from the intrinsic cotangent frame; the universal coordinate derivative has frame value one.
obligations.why_match: frame_pure and basis_normalized use the exact restriction/congruence/multiplication normalization, not an arbitrary generator.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: The generator must be one of the already constructed global bicanonical sections on the actual source.
obligations.constructed: The tensor object, global q0/q1 and exact local expressions are imported from the frozen global packet unchanged.
obligations.why_match: global_branch_generator and global_infinity_generator compose the actual global restriction equations with local generation.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: Every point and every subopen of an appropriate neighborhood must be covered.
obligations.constructed: Every finite branch i:Fin4 is handled, and the full infinity chart is handled. The prior five-chart cover covers every source point.
obligations.why_match: generate_on_neighborhood explicitly quantifies over all subopens of the selected neighborhood; it is stronger than one global-section test.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: The local frame and global-to-local restriction maps must be actual sheaf maps.
obligations.constructed: ambientFrame starts with the exact restrictUnitIso and inverse tensor frame. Global restriction composition uses presheaf.map_comp and the frozen q0/q1_restrict equations.
obligations.why_match: The basis value is exactly one, and composition gives the same actual local section; no scalar or transport is left unspecified.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: Local generation must apply to the actual globally glued pair, not merely a replacement local pair.
obligations.constructed: The statements mention ContactGlobalBicanonical318.q0 and .q1 literally.
obligations.why_match: The proof first establishes the exact restriction equalities on every subopen and then transfers bijectivity.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: All c_i powers and coordinate choices must agree with the global packet.
obligations.constructed: The existing branchQ0_unit and infinityQ1_unit theorems are used with the same coefficient and coordinate definitions.
obligations.why_match: No coefficient is changed. Unit status maps through GammaSpecIso, chart appIso and the actual restriction map before multiplying the normalized basis.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: Generation must include finite ramification points and all infinity points, without cancelling a vanishing coordinate.
obligations.constructed: Finite q0 is a unit coefficient on the entire finite branch chart; infinity q1 is a unit coefficient on the entire infinity chart.
obligations.why_match: Neither z_i nor u is inverted in these local generation arguments. The all-subopen statement follows from an actual local frame.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: Zero twists, omitted branch indices or endpoints, and an empty-subopen loophole must not weaken the conclusion.
obligations.constructed: Twists remain arbitrary Q-units, every branch is included, and the chosen neighborhood explicitly contains the supplied point.
obligations.why_match: The theorem covers all points and all W≤V, including the actual nonempty neighborhood V containing x. q0 is allowed to vanish at infinity because q1 generates there.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: A base-point-free local-generating pair is required before constructing its associated projective morphism.
obligations.constructed: At every point, one global section freely generates the sheaf throughout a whole neighborhood.
obligations.why_match: This supplies the local-generation input. An explicit projective map, linear independence and degree remain separate endpoints; none is inferred here.

consumer: Exact input for a future projective morphism associated to the pair; no such morphism or PEL/KS consequence claimed.
